data.one_liner: Partial Bootstrap Grid implementation for Flutter responsive layouts.
data.what_it_does: Provides Bootstrap‑style grid widgets (Container, Row, Col, Visibility) and helper methods for responsive design. It supports Bootstrap4 grid classes and conditional visibility based on screen width.
use_when: You need a familiar Bootstrap‑like grid system in Flutter
You want to build responsive UIs with breakpoints and column offsets
You prefer declarative widget composition over manual layout calculations
avoid_when: You require full Bootstrap feature parity (e.g., utilities, components beyond grid)
You need advanced layout features like flexbox customizations not covered by the grid
strengths: Easy to adopt for developers familiar with Bootstrap
Built‑in support for breakpoints, offsets, and order
Declarative API fits Flutter’s widget model
weaknesses: Partial implementation – missing many Bootstrap utilities
Limited to grid and visibility; no other Bootstrap components

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a more comprehensive responsive layout system with breakpoints and adaptive widgets

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a similar grid‑like API and additional utilities for responsive design
